arabic text: AY SHIMR ZARA\nKUCH REHM TO KHA\nYE CHOTI ZAHRA HAI
english translation text: O SHIMR, HAVE\nSOME MERCY, THIS IS\nA LITTLE ZAHRA

arabic text: NA MAAR ISSE\nNAZON SE ISSE\nSHABBIR NE PAALA HAI
english translation text: DON’T HIT HER, WITH\nGREAT LOVE AND CARE,\nHUSSAIN HAS BROUGHT HER UP

arabic text: SAJJAD KI BEHNA KO GHAZI KI BHATIJI KO\nMANGA HAI KANEEZI ME IS PHOOL SI BACHI KO\nSHEH NE APNE SAJDO ME ISSE ALLAH SE MANGA HAI
english translation text: THE SISTER OF SAJJAD THE NIECE OF ABBAS\nTHEY HAVE TREATED THIS LITTLE GIRL LIKE A SLAVE\nTHE ONE WHO HUSSAIN USED TO PRAY FOR

arabic text: DORENGE AGAR NAQE KIS TARHA SAMBHLEGI\nAWAAZ KISSE DEGI GAR RAAH ME GIR JAAYE\nPUSHTE NAQA PER KYUN TANHA RASSI SE BANDHA HAI
english translation text: WHEN THE CAMELS GO FAST, HOW WILL SHE HANDLE THIS?\nIF SHE FALLS ON THE ROAD, WHO WILL SHE CALL OUT TO?\nWHY HAVE YOU TIED HER ALONE WITH ROPES ON THE CAMEL

arabic text: KYA JURM KIYA ISNE KYUN ISKO RULATA HAI\nDIKHLA KE ISSE PAANI MATTI PE BAHATA HAI\nKYA TERI KOI AWLAD NAHI KYUN ZULM YE DHATA HAI
english translation text: WHAT HAS SHE DONE WRONG, WHY DO YOU MAKE HER CRY\nYOU SHOW HER WATER, THEN SPILL IT ON THE FLOOR\nDO YOU NOT HAVE A FAMILY? WHY DO YOU OPPRESS LIKE THIS?

arabic text: RONE NA DIYA ISKO BABA KE LAASHE PER\nHAI NEEL TAMACHO KE MASUMA KE CHEHRE PER\nALLAH JAANE YEH ISPE SITAM KIS BAAT KA BADLA HAI
english translation text: YOU DIDN’T LET HER CRY AT HER FATHER’S GRAVE\nHER CHEEKS ARE RED FROM THE MARKS OF THE SLAPS!\nONLY GOD KNOWS, ALL THIS TORTURE – WHAT ARE THEY AVENGING

arabic text:
EK RAAT SARE ZINDAAN SHABBIR KA SAR AYA
BACHI NE KIYA NOHA
SAR LEKAR GODI ME
BABA DEKHO, AANKHEN KHOLO YEH KAUN ZAEEFA HAI
english translation text:
ONE NIGHT IN THE PRISON OF SHAAM THE
HEAD OF HUSSAIN WAS BROUGHT SHE TOOK THE
HEAD IN HER LAPS AND STARTED WEEPING LOOK
FATHER, OPEN YOUR EYES, LOOK AT MY STATE

arabic text: MASOOM KI GARDAN ME BANDHI HAI RASAN AISE\nGHUT JAAEGA DAM ISKA ME TEZ CHALUN KAISE\nYEH KEHTA HUWA, BIMAR MERA KHAM HOKAR CHALTA HAI
english translation text: ON THE NECK OF THE INNOCENT GIRL, THEY HAVE TIED ROPES\nSHE WILL SUFFOCATE LIKE THIS, HOW CAN I WALK ANY FASTER\nWHILST SAYING THIS, SAJJAD WOULD WALK WITH HIS BACK BROKEN

arabic text: ROZE PE NAZAR JAB BHI AY SHADMAN JAATI HAI\nPHIR QALB E TAKALLUM KO YE BAAT RULAATI HAI\nCHOTI BIBI SADIYAAN GUZRI ZINDAAN ME TANHA HAI
english translation text: WHENEVER WE LOOK AT HER SHRINE\nTHEN THE HEART ACHES, AND WE CRY\nIT HAS BEEN YEARS, THIS LITTLE GIRL HAS BEEN ALL ALONE IN THE PRISON

arabic text: DIKHLA KE ISE PAANI, MATTI PE BAHAATA HA\nBACCHI NE KIYA NAUHA SAR LE KAR GODI ME,\nAANKHEIN KHOLO, BABA DEKHO,YE KAUN ZA'IFA HAI
english translation text: YOU TAUNT HER BY SHOWING HER WATER, THEN SPILL IT\nON THE FLOOR SHE TOOK THE HEAD INTO HER LAP\nAND WAILED OPEN YOUR EYES, O BABA, LOOK AT MY STATE!

arabic text: TURBAT PE SAKINA KI, ABID NE KAHA HOGA\nYE MERI AMAANAT HAI, RAKHNA TU KHAYAAL ISKA\nBABA BHI NAHI, AMMU BHI NAHI,BE AAS YATIMA HAI
english translation text: SAJJAD LAMENTED AT THE GRAVE OF SAKINA THIS IS\nMY POSSESSION, TAKE GOOD CARE OF HER NO FATHER,\nNO UNCLE, SHE IS AN ORPHAN WITH NO HOPE
